WITH e AS (
 SELECT e.*, m.member_id, m.marketing_consent, m.valid_from, m.valid_to,
  CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', e.contact_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS contact_date
 FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key
 WHERE e.campaign_id=19)
SELECT count(*) AS rows, count(DISTINCT exposure_id) AS dist_exp, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN delivered THEN member_id END) AS delivered_members,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19) THEN member_id END) AS in_holdout,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT marketing_consent THEN member_id END) AS no_consent_members,
 min(contact_date) AS mind, max(contact_date) AS maxd,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN contact_date NOT BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' THEN member_id END) AS outside_window,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN contact_date < valid_from OR contact_date > valid_to THEN member_id END) AS outside_version,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT exposure_id FROM stg_campaign_contact_load WHERE campaign_id=19)) AS stg_rows
FROM e

WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19),
web AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order),
lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, st.store_id, p.category, mm.member_id,
         f.channel_code, w.status, w.dispatch_date,
         CASE WHEN st.store_id=900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS eff_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_member mm ON mm.member_key=f.member_key
  LEFT JOIN web w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE mm.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM targeted))
SELECT
 count(*) AS rows_all,
 count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_line,
 count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rcpt_line,
 sum(CASE WHEN eff_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_range_rows,
 sum(CASE WHEN eff_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test' AND (store_id<>900 OR status IN ('delivered','collected')) THEN net_amount END) AS net_clean,
 sum(CASE WHEN eff_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND store_id=999 THEN net_amount END) AS net_999,
 sum(CASE WHEN eff_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND category='ZZ Test' THEN net_amount END) AS net_zz,
 sum(CASE WHEN eff_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND store_id=900 AND status NOT IN ('delivered','collected') THEN net_amount END) AS net_web_notdispatched,
 sum(CASE WHEN eff_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND store_id=900 AND dispatch_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_null_dispatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN store_id=900 AND sale_date_chk THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dummy
FROM (SELECT *, false AS sale_date_chk FROM lines)

calls.statement:
WITH d AS (
 SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.member_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at,
  count(*) OVER () AS total_dup_rows
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id
LIMIT 40

WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19),
web AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order),
raw AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.net_amount, st.store_id, p.category, mm.member_id, w.status,
         CASE WHEN st.store_id=900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS eff_date,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no ORDER BY f.sales_line_id) AS rn
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_member mm ON mm.member_key=f.member_key
  LEFT JOIN web w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE mm.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM targeted)),
scoped AS (
  SELECT * FROM raw
  WHERE eff_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
    AND store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test' AND (store_id<>900 OR status IN ('delivered','collected')))
SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM targeted) AS members_contacted,
  count(*) AS lines_all, sum(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lines_dedup,
  count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members_with_spend,
  sum(net_amount) AS net_raw, sum(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN net_amount END) AS net_dedup,
  sum(CASE WHEN rn=1 AND store_id=900 THEN net_amount END) AS net_web,
  (SELECT count(*)-count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order) AS web_dup_orders
FROM scoped

  sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test' THEN r.refund_net END) AS refund_test

WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
  WHERE e.campaign_id = 19
),
web AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order
),
spend AS (
  SELECT SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_spend
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member mm ON mm.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE mm.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM targeted)
    AND st.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND (st.store_id <> 900 OR w.status IN ('delivered', 'collected'))
    AND CASE WHEN st.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END
        BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
)
SELECT 19 AS campaign_id, 'Spring Garden Launch 2026' AS campaign_name,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM targeted) AS members_contacted,
       (SELECT ROUND(net_spend, 2) FROM spend) AS net_spend_eur_excl_vat
